title: ReViP: Reducing False Completion in Vision-Language-Action Models with Vision-Proprioception Rebalance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on a custom False-Completion Benchmark Suite using controlled perturbations (Object Drop, Distractor Swap, and Object Relayout) to measure the models' over-reliance on internal proprioceptive states over real-time visual evidence.
